name: Ivana Kovačić
bio:
Ivana Kovačić's journey into the world of motorsport was a happy accident. Originally a marketing professional in the tourism sector, she stumbled upon a local karting event during a promotional campaign. Captivated by the roar of the engines and the passionate atmosphere, she felt an immediate connection. She transitioned into motorsport marketing a few years later, bringing her expertise in brand building and customer engagement to smaller racing teams before landing at Cavaleiro Sports.

At Cavaleiro, Ivana thrives on crafting compelling narratives that connect with fans and sponsors alike. She has a knack for identifying unique angles and leveraging them to enhance brand visibility. While she is not a technical expert, her ability to translate the complex world of motorsport into relatable and engaging content is invaluable. Her colleagues appreciate her meticulous planning and calm demeanor, which keeps marketing projects on track, even amidst the frenetic pace of racing.

What sets Ivana apart is her unwavering commitment to her team. She genuinely believes in the vision of Cavaleiro Sports and is determined to make them a household name. Her loyalty and dedication are infectious, fostering a collaborative and supportive environment within the marketing department.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy hair with subtle graying at the temples, often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Ivana is a woman of medium height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Always has a thermos of strong Croatian coffee on her desk.
Meticulously color-codes her calendar entries with racing event schedules.
Insists on using a physical notepad for brainstorming sessions, claiming it sparks more creativity.
